title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Goal for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on top risks and blockers across API, Console, Dedicated, Private flows
- Align on engineering capacity, near-term prioritization, and any cross-team pulls
- Agree owners & deadlines for follow-ups and customer asks

Context / recent highlights:
- API: noticed small but consistent latency bump on text-generation endpoints over last 2 weeks (p50 +10ms, p95 +60ms). Likely correlated with kernel change rollout (v2.14) on prod clusters.
- Console: rollout plan for per-route dashboards feature is in staging; UX signoff done, aiming for canary next week. Need to confirm tracing hooks and cost breakdowns are enabled for canary users.
- Dedicated: two enterprise customers asking about predictable burst capacity for Q2 launches - sales pushing for clearer SLA language and a sizing exercise.
- Private: one PoC is stuck on private control plane bootstrapping behind corporate VPC (customer has strict egress rules). Needs networking playbook and maybe SRE pairing.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick status check (5m)
   - Anything urgent I should know?
2) API perf regressions (10m)
   - What diagnostics have you run? Any backfill or revert candidate?
   - Short-term mitigations: throttling, fallback model variant, kernel pinning?
   - Owner / ETA for root-cause follow-up: who owns postmortem?
3) Console canary readiness (5m)
   - Are tracing hooks + cost metrics ready? Any missing telemetry?
   - Confirm rollout guardrails and rollback plan
4) Dedicated capacity / SLA ask (5m)
   - Capacity sizing: what inputs do you need from sales?
   - Is there a config we can offer as an interim that's low effort?
5) Private deployment blocker & SRE help (3m)
   - Who can pair with customer network team? Any runbook gaps?
6) Wrap & action items (2m)

Notes / talking points I want to raise:
- API perf: customers are sensitive to p95 latency spikes - even small regressions drive support tickets. If kernel change is suspect, can we isolate by region/model type to throttle impact?
- Consider temporary routing policy to prefer earlier kernel version for latency-sensitive routes while non-critical routes use v2.14.
- For Console canary, product needs per-route cost breakdown accuracy within +/-10% for the first wave. If tracing not available, can we add sampling + rough estimate as fallback?
- Dedicated: propose a template calcsheet for sales: baseline throughput, expected token mix, headroom/burst multiplier, and estimated GPU count. Engineering could review once sales fills it out.
- Private: customer expects onboarding within 4 weeks; if SRE pairing required, we need to flag allocation. Could use a 2-3 day dedicated eng + 1 SRE for first week.

Open questions / decisions needed from Eng lead:
- Approve short-term kernel pinning + routing policy for latency-sensitive routes?
- Capacity: OK to produce a templated sizing worksheet and offer 1-week SRE pairing for pilot customers as paid add-on?
- Console canary: approve go/no-go criteria (tracing present OR fallback estimators in place)

Action items (who / what / when):
- [Eng Lead / Samir] Run targeted perf diff between v2.13 and v2.14 on top 3 gen models by Fri 2026-03-05. Report p50/p95 deltas and allocated queues.
- [Eng / Maya] Draft routing policy change that pins critical routes to v2.13 and fallback rules, ready for my review by Tue 2026-03-03.
- [Product / Jordan] Share customer sizing template with sales & schedule review session by 2026-03-08.
- [SRE] Assign one SRE and one backend eng for Private PoC pairing; confirm availability by 2026-03-04.
- [Console Eng] Verify tracing + cost telemetry for canary customers or implement estimator fallback by 2026-03-06.
- [Eng Lead] Sign off on temporary SLA language for Dedicated burst offering by 2026-03-10 so sales can include in proposals.

Prep for follow-up:
- I'll collect the customer examples with timestamps of latency spikes and link them in the follow-up Confluence page (CONFLUENCE:API-PERF-2026).
- If Samir approves kernel pin approach, I'll draft the comms for support + status page and include rollback notes.

Misc notes / things to watch:
- If perf diff looks model-specific (decoder vs encoder-decoder) we should avoid global rollbacks - consider per-model kernel selection.
- Watch the cost telemetry accuracy on console side: mismatches >15% will break trust for enterprise customers.
- Ensure Dedicated sizing defaults include quantization profile and expected cache hit rates (these materially affect GPU needs).

Back-of-envelope numbers I might ask for in the meeting:
- Typical enterprise burst ask: 2-5x baseline throughput for up to 12 hours - need to know if we can support with existing burst pool or require reserved capacity.
- Console canary sample size: 5-10 routes / 50-100 users to validate telemetry without impacting stability.

If time permits in meeting:
- Quick brainstorm on long-term: automated rollback triggers based on p95 delta + error rate threshold, and improved perf regression alerts integrated with PR gating.

End.
summary: 1:1 prep doc for PM Jordan Alvarez to align with Eng lead on API perf regressions, Console canary readiness, Dedicated capacity/SLA, and Private PoC blockers. Includes agenda, notes, decisions needed, and action items.
